headline: Profitability jumps, prompting raised earnings guidance
summary_short: Amentum's fiscal Q3 2026 revenue fell 2% y/y to $3,490 million, while net income rose to $66 million from $10 million and adjusted diluted EPS rose 20% to $0.67.
summary_long: Revenue fell 2% y/y to $3,490M as contract transitions to unconsolidated joint ventures and FY2025 divestitures (a 3-point drag) were only partly offset by new awards in digital infrastructure and space systems. Operating income rose 67% on strong operational performance and lower intangible amortization; net income and diluted EPS improved further on lower interest expense. Adjusted EBITDA margin expanded 60bp to 8.3% on margin-expansion initiatives and favorable mix. Backlog reached $48.2B (+8% y/y) on $17.7B of net bookings, including a $974M NASA IDIQ award and $400M+ in nuclear-energy wins. Management raised FY2026 Adjusted EBITDA guidance to $1,115-$1,140M and Adjusted Diluted EPS guidance to $2.40-$2.50, while lowering revenue guidance to $13,800-$13,950M; free-cash-flow guidance of $525-$575M was held.
confidence_notes: Amentum's fiscal quarter ended July 3, 2026 (labeled fiscal Q3 2026 by the company); the shard files it under the calendar-quarter label FY2026 Q2, a several-day offset from the company's own fiscal calendar.

drivers.explanation: Decline was driven by a 3-point impact from contract transitions to unconsolidated joint ventures and FY2025 divestitures, partly offset by ramp-up of new awards in critical digital infrastructure and space systems.
Growth reflected strong operational performance and decreased intangible amortization expense.
Improvement was supported by higher operating income and lower interest expense.
Growth was driven by $17.7 billion of net bookings and a 1.3x last-twelve-months book-to-bill, including large nuclear-energy, digital-infrastructure, defense, and NASA awards.
Management cited strong operating performance, profitability, and free cash flow, and raised full-year Adjusted EBITDA and Adjusted Diluted EPS guidance despite near-term revenue headwinds.
